name: Tempered Garrote
description: Send a pulse down the forearm meridians as the cord snaps taut across the target's collar.

name: Ironnoose
description: Brace both feet and let the cord flex as a beam against a charging shoulder.

name: Hamstringing Gripdowel
description: Hook the cord behind a running shin and draw the leg out from under its owner.

name: Silt Cinch
description: Weave between two guards in short steps so neither feels the cord pass behind them.

name: Subduing Barbedwire
description: Wind the loop around an arm and drive qi through the turns until the limb cannot bend.

name: Facet Toggle
description: Rake the taut cord across the nerve cluster at the side of the neck to numb the shoulder.

name: Gyvestrand
description: Drive the whole meridian flow into the cord and drag a struggling champion to the ground by the neck.

name: Glint Wirebraid
description: Catch a grabbing arm in the loop and let its own pull draw the cord tight.

name: Togglecloak
description: Hold both hands at the sternum in a loose stance with the cord hanging ready in an open loop.

name: Fastening Cordhandle
description: Shift weight over the front foot and throw the loop past arm's length to catch a neck at distance.

name: Might Throttle
description: Pace in a slow orbit around the target so the loop crosses their line of sight only once.

name: Gust Cordbraid
description: Flick the cord's end at the target's eye line to force a blink before the true draw.

name: Immovable Wirecore
description: Sheathe the cord in a skin of field qi so edged weapons slide along it without cutting.

name: Stifling Slipknot
description: Extend the field around the loop and let it settle over a neck two paces beyond the arms.

name: Crippling Tighten
description: Pull so a ripple of field qi runs down the cord and breaks the target's channeled technique.

name: Shade Handlebar
description: Let the cord live as part of the field, tightening as the target's own qi pushes against it.

name: Crippling Slipnoose
description: Lock the knot with a burst of field qi so the loop halts the flow of qi through the neck.

name: Noosering Plating
description: Pivot with the loop on one foe's neck so the second foe's strike must pass through him.

name: Granite Handlebar
description: Step so one foe stands between you and the other with the cord running taut between them.

name: Unmaking Noosering
description: Sweep the taut cord waist high to rake the shins of the nearest attackers.

name: Chime Gripdowel
description: Cross the cord over the body to turn a thrust coming from the flank.

name: Gyve Constrict
description: Drag one foe into another by the cord and tangle both in the same loop.

name: Facet Cordbraid
description: Turn on the held foe as an anchor so every blow meets his back first.

name: Doctrine Slipknot
description: Cast three loops in order at three necks, each tightening as the next leaves the hand.

name: Sinister Cordhandle Cloak
description: Stretch the cord ankle high across a narrow passage so a pursuer trips and tangles.

name: Thornstrand
description: Hold the long cord out front as a taut bar so a charging attacker runs into it.

name: Thorn Cinch
description: Cast the loop from the full length of the cord and gather the slack as it lands.

name: Gustwire
description: Sweep the far foot wide in a curve so the cord arcs past the target's shoulder.

name: Rumble Toggle
description: Crack the cord overarm so its tip lands at the neck before the loop closes.

name: Gustnoose
description: Catch a descending cut on the free hand's wrapped palm and turn it clear of the loop.

name: Ponderous Wirecore
description: Stretch the cord's reach by a hand's breadth with a streak of qi to ensnare a retreating limb.

name: Toggleplating
description: Pluck the taut line so a ringing note jars the target's channeled technique.

name: Raging Garrote
description: Snake the loop through a gap in the defense and settle it round the exposed throat.

name: Ponderous Barbedwire
description: Hold a strangling pull from the cord's full length while the field draws the target onward.

name: Thorn Wirecore
description: Whirl the cord in a ring about the body to knock aside darts and thrown knives.

name: Ponderous Wirebraid
description: Cross the two cord ends over the target's neck in a paired loop and pull each hand outward.

name: Hoarfrost Cordbraid
description: Hold the hands at twin heights, high and low, so the cord screens both throat and belt.

name: Siltwire
description: Flow behind the target in unbroken steps, as a river turns around a stone.

name: Toggleassault
description: Draw both ends outward in one clean line that slaps across the target's collar.

name: Intentwire
description: Pull with the body track below and the qi track above, each carrying half the strain.

name: Gyvetoggle
description: Drop the loop from above like a stooping hawk and close it before the head can lift.

name: Togglecuirass
description: Set a paired snare at the lip of a stair or basin edge so a retreating foot catches in it.

name: Wireplating
description: Close both loops of the pair at once so qi stops at the neck and cannot rise to the head.

name: Adamant Wirebraid
description: Hold the paired cords wide like wings and watch the target's shoulders for the first move.

name: Hoarfrost Tighten
description: Cast the loop in a curve like a river bend to come around a raised guard.

name: Silt Cordhandle
description: Turn on both heels together to put the paired cords behind the target before he spins.

name: Constrict Assault
description: Draw one hand wide and the other tight so a thin line flicks the target's jaw upward.

name: Thorn Gripdowel
description: Wrap each cord on the target's opposite wrist and cross them to bind both arms.

name: Thornwire
description: Gather field qi in a basin about the hands so the cord rests in it untouched by edges.

name: Vaulting Noosering
description: Drop on a retreating target in a single stoop with the paired cords trailing behind you.

name: Murk Slipnoose
description: Whisper one cord across the face while the second slips in unseen at the neck.

name: Strandthrash
description: Run field qi down both cords at once so the pair closes on the neck from either side.

name: Rumble Slipknot
description: Release both tracks together in a flare of qi that cuts a channeled technique short.

name: Implacable Toggle
description: Open with the formal salute, cord raised overhead in both hands, then lower it as a guard.

name: Thorn Throttle
description: Cast two loops together, one high and one low, to catch both neck and wrist.

name: Granite Tighten
description: Step in a river-crossing pattern, each foot placed where the other has just left, to flank a target.

name: Granite Barbedwire
description: Snap the cord out like a hawk's strike at a hand reaching for a weapon.

name: Fastening Constrict
description: Weave two threads of qi along the paired cords so the knot cannot be picked apart.

name: Barbedwire Cloak
description: Let the cord go slack inside the azure field so a blow slides along it harmlessly.

name: Handlebar Maelstrom
description: Spiral the pull like water draining from a basin, tightening more with every turn.

name: Fastening Cinch
description: Close the paired cords at the throat in the court's formal draw, cutting off the qi flow.

name: Wirebraid Assault
description: Stoop like a hawk, close like a river, and weave the cords in one chained motion.

name: Thorn Handlebar
description: Stand square as at a plateau edge with the cord taut across the chest, giving no ground.

name: Ponderous Cinch
description: Cast the loop downwind so the drift of the air carries it to the target's neck.

name: Gust Slipnoose
description: Take a bearing on the target's back and walk it without deviation.

name: Gust Gripdowel
description: Snap the cord taut in the first draw of the oath, a short hard blow to the shoulder.

name: Unshaken Noosering
description: Fold the slack into the wind of a passing blow and let the cord ride along it.

name: Gyve Throttle
description: Hold the loop closed on a struggling target and keep the qi steady like a sworn word.

name: Shade Cordhandle
description: Pull in long surges like a gale across the plateau, each surge tightening what the last gained.

name: Gyvenoose
description: Tie a knot that holds against all strain until the tyer's own hand frees it.

name: Thorn Cordbraid
description: Hold the cord low and wide across the body so a rush meets only tension and open ground.

name: Noosecuirass
description: Throw the loop on a gust of breath and shifting hips so it drops over a distant neck.

name: Wirecanter
description: Turn on the held bearing and sweep around the target's weak side.

name: Tempered Slipknot
description: Whip the free end in a hissing arc across the target's lead hand.

name: Murk Wirecore
description: Turn the cord along its oath line to carry a stabbing wrist past your ribs.

name: Noosegreave
description: Spread field qi along the open length of the cord until it grips whatever it touches.

name: Granite Toggle
description: Drift behind a target on a wind-sworn step, cord trailing and touching only at the last instant.

name: Chimewire
description: Read the target's heading through the cord laid across the shoulder and correct each pull to it.

name: Intent Tighten
description: Run field qi in gusts down the cord to tighten the loop in surges at the target's neck.

name: Toxin Wirecore
description: Release the cord with a crack of qi so the surge breaks a technique the target is mid-channel.

name: Facet Slipknot
description: Plant the feet on the line of the wind and hold the cord out as a taut bar.

name: Stifling Constrict
description: Cast the loop across the wind so it curls back onto the neck.

name: Wirebraid Jaunt
description: Step along one heading and let the target's own turns bring him into the cord.

name: Wrecking Constrict
description: Draw the cord across an exposed throat in a flat cut with the full weight behind it.

name: Mightwire
description: Lash the cord on a fixed bearing so its tip finds the pressure point behind the ear.

name: Silencing Garrote
description: Let a steady push of qi, like a held wind, keep the loop shut while you step away.

name: Unshaken Toggle
description: Retreat behind a swirl of slack cord so a pursuing blow strikes only empty air.

name: Toxin Handlebar
description: Stretch a hidden cord low across a narrow plateau path, staked to rock at one end.

name: Wirebarrage
description: Take a bearing on the target's throat and hold one unbroken pull until resistance ends.
